'''Zander''' (Japanese: '''ゼンキチ''' ''Zenkichi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG142|Caterpie's Big Dilemma]]''.

A student of [[Dr. Gordon]]'s, Zander appears to spend most of his time at the doctor's lab. It was there that the young boy met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, who he believed were thieves trying to sneak into the lab. When he realized that they were actually heading to [[Saffron City]], he immediately apologized.

Soon afterwards, {{TRT}} broke into the doctor's lab and spilled some of Dr. Gordon's Mystery Candy Complete, which a {{p|Caterpie}} that Zander had been caring for immediately ate. The {{t|Bug}} Pokémon immediately began growing to [[Giant Pokémon|enormous proportions]] before escaping the lab and wreaking havoc in a nearby city.

Suddenly, Team Rocket reappeared and kidnapped Dr. Gordon, fleeing on their giant {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}}, who had also been fed the Mystery Candy Complete. Caterpie eventually evolved into a Metapod, and again into {{p|Butterfree}}. With the help of Zander and Ash, it saved the doctor from Team Rocket. Afterwards, Butterfree shrunk back down to its normal size. Zander was proud of Butterfree for saving the doctor and vowed to train it and bade farewell to Ash and the others, hoping that he and Ash would meet again someday.

{{p|Butterfree}} first appeared as a Caterpie, where it confronted {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, using String Shot to tie the suspected thieves up. Zander soon apologized after realizing his mistake.

Later, Caterpie defeated {{TRT}} from stealing [[Dr. Gordon]]'s lab blueprints with the help of {{AP|Pikachu}}. Afterwards, Caterpie found and ate one of the doctor's experimental "Mystery Candy Complete", causing it to continually grow and eventually cause destruction to a nearby city. Caterpie stopped its unintended rampage to rest on a city radio tower so it could evolve, eventually into a Butterfree. With its new wings, Butterfree, alongside Zander and Ash, pursued Team Rocket and their giant {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}} to rescue the kidnapped Dr. Gordon. Shortly afterwards, Butterfree reverted to its original size.
